messages:
Rae: quick UX note from a customer session — on very narrow viewports (~320px) the left-edge swipe to open the rail conflicts with table horizontal pans. Users keep opening rail instead of scrolling cells. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/ux/320-rail-conflict.png :eyes:
Tom: repro steps? device/UA?
Rae: iPhone SE + Android small devices, Chrome & Safari. Table has long monospaced IDs so we allow horizontal scroll. Edge-swipe threshold seems pretty wide right now.
Becky: metric: small but consistent uptick in mobile row-action abandonment for US-East last week. Likely related.
Ivy: accessibility point — when the rail opens mid-scroll it steals focus and TalkBack/VoiceOver reads the rail items unexpectedly. Also the visible handle has low contrast on dark mode.
Tom: plan: (A) reduce edge gesture zone to 10px under 360px width, (B) add element-level opt-out: `.no-rail-swipe` for containers with horizontal scroll, (C) change copy for mobile action buttons: "Details" -> "Open panel" to clarify overlay behavior. I'll prototype.
Rae: +1 to copy. Also propose making the rail behave as modal under 360px (trap focus) so it's clear it overlays content rather than pushing it.
Tom: CSS/JS snippet I'll try:
```css
@media (max-width: 360px){
  .gesture-edge { width: 10px; }
  .console-table { touch-action: pan-y; }
}
```
```js
if (el.closest('.has-h-scroll')) el.classList.add('no-rail-swipe')
gestureLib.setEdgeThreshold(10)
```
Ivy: ensure the modal-rail has aria-modal=true and that focus returns to the triggering row action when closed. Also make the peek handle focusable with `aria-label="Open rail"` and >=44x44 hit area.
Luis: agree with modal behavior + copy tweak. Can we ship copy change independently if frontend needs more time? It's a small copy push.
Tom: yes, can split: PR A for copy-only, PR B for gesture logic + a11y. I'll open both.
edge-bot: automation note - added mobile-gesture tests to nightly (build 2026.05.03-09).
Tom: PRs created: https://git.redwood/PR/4680 (copy only), https://git.redwood/PR/4681 (gesture + a11y WIP).
Rae: scheduling a 10m test sesh on staging after PR 4681 lands. Becky, Ivy, Tom, Rae? 11am PT tomorrow works for me.
Becky: added to calendar.
Ivy: will run VoiceOver & TalkBack quick pass and update accessibility checklist in the PR.
Tom: will post staging links + screenshots when ready. Thanks all :sparkles:
